# Open Thread 461

**From:** Astral Codex Ten <astralcodexten@substack.com>  
**Date:** 2026-11-24T00:16:22.000Z

---

View this post on the web at https://www.astralcodexten.com/p/open-thread-461

This is the weekly visible open thread. Post about anything you want, ask random questions, whatever. ACX has an unofficial subreddit [ https://substack.com/redirect/b89dff07-0e8c-4309-b813-9156e254dbe1?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], Discord [ https://substack.com/redirect/7a857ba4-9b1b-4f7a-b6ea-e1bc4d66c7bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], and bulletin board [ https://substack.com/redirect/1be2cee1-70c6-4034-818c-78ddab62feb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], and in-person meetups around the world [ https://substack.com/redirect/cb3633bf-f72f-4058-a94f-d41ca4020ad4?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ]. Most content is free, some is subscriber only; you can subscribe here [ https://substack.com/redirect/0f5ac56c-777a-443b-aecb-810dedfd6414?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ]. Also:
1: In The AI Forecasting Agenda [ https://substack.com/redirect/3c5acfbc-5fd1-4020-bc66-5e78595f2a6c?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], I mentioned three AI forecasting companies. My goal was to name everyone in the space and not play favorites, but this field is moving so fast that I inevitably missed someone, and in this case it was Cassi [ https://substack.com/redirect/8b0b2376-df3f-4a9b-a65d-61a3e88bd5a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], a British startup which is currently the top-ranked AI on Metaculus’ leaderboard [ https://substack.com/redirect/b8ff8e4f-3bb2-4974-99ea-ff4393e4e7a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ]. The Cassi team kindly wrote a post responding to my agenda [ https://substack.com/redirect/2650f8ca-5759-4fda-b15e-7a8e9c3eeb75?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ] - most notably, they are pretty confident in their conditional forecasts and say they’re already providing them to institutional paid customers. 
If you’re another AI forecasting startup I forgot to mention, feel free to get in touch with me at scott@slatestarcodex.com. Again, I’m not trying to play favorites (although companies that give me free demo access are naturally more likely to have results from their products mentioned in posts).
